title: 物理学基礎実験
subtitle: Basic Experiments in Physics
teachers:
TSUYUMOTO Isao
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
●To understand basic knowledge and skills for physics experiments, which include the basic operation of laboratory equipment and safety precautions.
●To understand the methods of data processing using computer.
●To design and conduct physics experiments, and to analyze and report the results
 of them.
●To plan, conduct, and teach physics experiments in the subject "Science" in secondary school.
advice: This course mainly aims at students who wish to be science teachers at secondary school.  Through learning basic physics experiments, students will acquire knowledge on how to operate laboratory equipment and safety necessary for conducting experiments in the subject "Science" of secondary school.  Students will experience how to conduct experimental lessons in the subject "Science".
requiredKnowledge: In order to teach Science at secondary school, it is necessary to understand knowledge of physics in senior high school.  Therefore, students should review high school physics thoroughly before this course.  This course does not only cover the contents specified in the Course of Study of Science, but also the laws of conservation of angular momentum in mechanics and Maxwell's equations in electromagnetism, which are useful for the subject "Science".

activityGoals.body: Be able to conduct experiments using instruments and devices appropriately in reference to an experiment guide.
Be able to process the data of the experimental results using a computer.
Be able to consider experimental results and explain formula and rules.
Be able to design experiment plans and conduct them.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Understand the physical formulas and laws accurately, and design experiment plans necessary for understanding them in the lessons of physics.

Prepare a physical experiment and conduct it safely in reference to an experiment guidebook by oneself.

Process the data of the experiments in physics using a computer, and consider them based on physical formulas and laws appropriately.
achievementLevels.standard:
Design experiment plans necessary for understanding them in the lessons of physics.

Prepare a physical experiment and conduct it safely in reference to an experiment guidebook.

Process the data of the experiments in physics using a computer, and consider them based on physical formulas and laws.

lessons.content:
Course guidance (the outline of this course,
the significance of physical experiments on the
subject "Science", safety education)

Motion of rigid body (1): law of conservation
of angular momentum

Motion of rigid body (2): cylinder rolling down
slope

Motion of simple pendulum (1): measurement of
period

Motion of simple pendulum (2): measurement of
damped vibration amplitude

Optics (1): measurement of refractive index of
liquid and glass

Optics (2): light diffraction and interference
by a diffraction grating

Measurement of electric resistance (1): DC two
terminal method

Measurement of electric resistance (2): DC four
terminal method

Application of oscilloscope (1): principle and
usage

Sound wave resonance (1): measure of speed of
sound in air

Sound wave resonance (2): measure of speed of
sound in helium

The plan of demonstration experiment and
presentation
The summary of this course

●To plan, conduct, and teach physics experiments in the subject "Science" in secondary school.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course mainly aims at students who wish to be science teachers at secondary school.  Through learning basic physics experiments, students will acquire knowledge on how to operate laboratory equipment and safety necessary for conducting experiments in the subject "Science" of secondary school.  Students will experience how to conduct experimental lessons in the subject "Science".

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              In order to teach Science at secondary school, it is necessary to understand knowledge of physics in senior high school.  Therefore, students should review high school physics thoroughly before this course.  This course does not only cover the contents specified in the Course of Study of Science, but also the laws of conservation of angular momentum in mechanics and Maxwell's equations in electromagnetism, which are useful for the subject "Science".
